neighbours.label: the thing being transferred in a genetic-engineering sentence: 'gene'/'it' between 'inserted/spliced a …' and 'into' the host organism; weak and inconsistent
fire: Biologists spliced a firefly gene into the tobacco plant.
The group inserted a bacterial gene into ordinary maize.
Her lab spliced a spider gene into the goat genome.
Engineers inserted a salmon gene into the strawberry.
They spliced a human gene into the yeast cells.
The breeders inserted a daffodil gene into white rice.
His team spliced a coral gene into the zebrafish.
Scientists inserted a wheat gene into the potato.

They named a human gene after the yeast researcher.

His team photographed a coral reef near the zebrafish tanks.
Scientists compared a wheat gene with the potato version.
